dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, let's play video games on Thursday evening!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlɛts ˈpleɪ ˈvɪdioʊ ˌɡeɪmz ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, Emma. I don't like playing video games. I only play games on my phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈɛmə. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈlaɪk ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊ ˌɡeɪmz. aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈpleɪ ˈɡeɪmz ɑːn maɪ ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh! Do you like board games?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! duː juː ˈlaɪk ˈbɔːrd ˌɡeɪmz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I don't mind playing board games. They're OK.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈmaɪnd ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈbɔːrd ˌɡeɪmz. ðɛr oʊˈkeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Or we can paint together. I love painting!
dialogue.reading: ɔːr wiː kən ˈpeɪnt təˈɡɛðər. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈpeɪntɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, I hate painting. It's difficult for me.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈheɪt ˈpeɪntɪŋ. ɪts ˈdɪfɪkəlt fər miː.
